values: Lowest-Cost Custom Quiz Website — Launch Checklist

Secure emailed link valid for 7 days

values: Your Setup Steps — No Coding Required
Complete these in order. When a row says “Ready for Codex,” change its Status to Done and add only a safe confirmation or dashboard link in Evidence / Link — never a secret key.
Choose the first quiz and price
Confirm quiz name, price/currency, and 10–15 questions. I can help write the questions.
Pick the inbox customers can use for payment or access problems.
Log in and confirm you can manage DNS records for the domain.
Use the free plan. Add your domain; I will tell you exactly which DNS records to approve.
Use your own legal/business details and bank account. Keep test mode until we finish testing.
Follow Stripe’s identity and bank verification prompts. This is required before payouts.
Use the free transactional-email plan for access emails.
Resend will show DNS records. Add them in Cloudflare/GoDaddy; I can guide you.
Open the existing Droplet dashboard when we are ready. No need to share password or API token.
Approve website design and quiz content
Review the desktop/mobile screens and result copy before implementation.
After all tests pass, approve the final switch from Stripe test mode to live mode.

Final end-to-end proof after you approve live mode.
